params.body:
Bumps the Pit extension that pi-assistant loads from `v0.36.3` to `v0.37.0` (#387, optional step 7).

With `v0.36.3`, this repository's `delivery.openPullRequest` and `pr.merge` project functions fail to load under pi-action, because they inject `git.revParse`, `git.switchBranch` and `git.pull`, which arrived in v0.37.0 (#385). The release run for #387 hit this and had to open and merge its PR by hand.
